task: Aspect sentiment and guidance from the latest earnings calls (brief: sentiment analysis of earnings calls; forecasting inputs)
read_by: Claude (claude-opus-5-5) via Claude Code, 13 Oct 2026; instruction in docs/ai_prompts.md (P4)
source: Q1 FY27 transcripts (Apr-Jun 2026) in data/raw/<ticker>/transcripts_FY27Q1.pdf; management prepared remarks plus, for Sun Pharma, management answers in the Q&A

HINDUNILVR.NS.call: Q1 FY27, 4 Aug 2026 (CEO Priya Nair, CFO Niranjan Gupta)

guidance.statement: FY27 expected to be better than FY26
Expected to stay around the current guided range (Q1: 23%)

aspects.evidence: USG 10%, highest in 13 quarters; half from volume (UVG 5%); growth up from 3% in H1 FY26
Gaining turnover-weighted market share
Calibrated price increases (crude derivatives, palm oil)
Inflation in crude-linked derivatives; palm oil inflation for a second year
EBITDA margin 23%, within the guided range
A&P Rs 1,657 Cr, highest in 11 quarters
Home Care 14% USG, Beauty & Wellbeing 12%, Foods 7%; Personal Care 4% (price-led)
Uncertain global environment; watching the monsoon; FMCG demand stable

watch_items: Commodity and currency inflation vs pricing power

SUNPHARMA.NS.call: Q1 FY27, Aug 2026 (Dilip Shanghvi, MD Kirti Ganorkar, CFO Jayashree Satagopan, US CEO Richard Ascroft)

guidance.statement: High single-digit growth for the full year (guidance maintained)
Shareholders approved; completion expected in Q4 FY27
Healthy growth expected, driven by new launches; no product-wise guidance

aspects.evidence: +16%; growing above the market; 50-60% of growth from volume and new products
+12.8% to USD 351 mn; Leqselvi passed 1,000 prescribers; Unloxcyt added to formularies
Lower sales from Lenalidomide erosion and extra competition
USD 218 mn, marginally lower; semaglutide launches in South Africa and Brazil
Healthier product mix lifting gross margin
R&D 5.4% of sales (30% innovative); launch spending described as sustained, not one-off
Large acquisition (>USD 10 bn reported); management declined questions on it

watch_items: Organon integration and the debt it may add

ICICIBANK.NS.call: Q1 FY27, 18 Jul 2026 (MD & CEO Sandeep Bakhshi, Group CFO Anindya Banerjee)

guidance.statement: Risk-calibrated profitable growth; grow market share across key segments
Maintain a strong balance sheet, prudent provisioning and healthy capital

aspects.evidence: +19.6% YoY; business banking +28.2%, rural incl. gold +35.4%, corporate +18.5%
+14.0% YoY, slower than loans; liquidity coverage about 124%
NIM 4.36% (4.32% last quarter); cost of deposits falling to 4.41%
Net NPA 0.35%; PCR 74.7%; contingency provisions Rs 13,100 Cr (0.8% of advances)
Opex +10.4%; 97 new branches
CET-1 16.19%, total capital adequacy 16.84%
Life and AMC profits up; general insurance profit halved (combined ratio 107.2%)
57% of domestic loans linked to repo / external benchmarks
